description: This file defines the PdfReference class, representing an indirect reference to a PdfObject within the PDF processing library. It includes methods for creating references, writing cross-reference entries, and dereferencing references, along with related properties and internal logic.

classes.name: PdfReference
classes.description: Represents an indirect reference to a PdfObject in a PDF document, managing object IDs, positions, the referenced object, and associated document context.

methods.name: CreateFromObject
methods.description: Creates a PdfReference instance from a given PdfObject, ObjectID, and position.

methods.name: CreateForObjectID
methods.description: Creates a PdfReference instance from an ObjectID and position, without a direct PdfObject reference.

methods.name: WriteXRefEntry
methods.description: Writes the reference's position and object ID information in PDF cross-reference table format.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Writes the indirect reference in the PDF document using the provided writer.

methods.name: ResetObject
methods.description: Resets the referenced object to null, used during reading object streams.
